summary: Oxford Square Capital Corp. filed an 8-K on September 14, 2026, announcing it notified U.S. Bank Trust Company, N.A., trustee, of its election to redeem $15.0 million aggregate principal of its 5.50% Notes due 2028 (OXSQG). The redemption date is October 14, 2026, at $25 per Note plus accrued interest from July 31, 2026. The Notes total $80.5 million issued and outstanding. No board recommendation or advisor was named. This partial debt retirement reduces leverage and interest expense; watch for potential impact on NAV, coverage ratios, and any further redemption notices.
